subject.title: claude-swap adapter: parse per-model scoped weekly windows (e.g. Fable) from cswap --list --json

question: Should the opt-in claude-swap Phase 1 contract expand to render optional per-model weekly `usage.scoped` windows alongside its existing 5-hour and 7-day rows?
rationale: The current design intentionally bounds the external adapter schema, so accepting an additional untrusted display field and adding card rows is a product and contract choice rather than a correction to an established guarantee.

options.title: Approve bounded scoped rows
options.body: Accept optional validated scoped rows as display-only usage data and implement them through the existing Claude quota-row presentation path.

options.title: Keep the Phase 1 boundary
options.body: Retain only account-wide 5-hour and 7-day windows for claude-swap until a broader adapter contract revision is desired.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded scoped rows
recommendation.body: Accept optional validated scoped rows as display-only usage data and implement them through the existing Claude quota-row presentation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the accepted Phase 1 claude-swap product contract and current release behavior.
